description: Instantly rollback to a previous working deploy. If deploy_id is omitted, rolls back to the most recent successful deploy. If deploy_id is provided, rolls back to that specific deploy. Returns the new deploy ID for the rollback. Use when check_app_health shows the app is broken after a deploy — rollback restores the app in seconds while you diagnose and fix the code. Returns HTTP 202 (async operation).

deploy_id.description: Specific deploy ID to rollback to. Omit to rollback to the most recent successful deploy.

name: rollback_deploy
